scope: Pinned public DbQA, LitQA2 and SuppQA configurations selected from the sheet-scoped literature/database source. The original MCQ protocol is source metadata; authored tasks run through Harbor. Other LAB-Bench categories and private questions are outside this inventory.

inventory_completeness.inspection: All 801 identities/hashes enumerated. Every DbQA stem matches one of ten query schemas and routes to seven existing contracts; candidate sets and biological records remain uninspected. All 82 SuppQA stems/citations reviewed: 58 provisional assignments, 24 gaps. The 199 literature endpoints remain unreviewed.

additional_projection.scope: Citation identifiers and paper titles only; no supplementary materials retrieved.

source_grading.protocol: Multiple-choice answer with optional abstention. This inventory excludes ideal/distractor columns, so candidate-specific answer equivalence is not established.
source_grading.adaptation: Harbor artifact contracts must specify independent candidates, complete retrieval scope and explicit missing-evidence behavior. Exact citation existence does not prove scientific entailment.

license_and_lineage: Dataset card declares CC-BY-SA-4.0. No benchmark questions, answer columns, passages or biological inputs are vendored or approved for training; independently sourced materials require their own rights and lineage checks.

task_defaults.assessment: Source identity and family enumerated; individual endpoint/candidate-set review and independent Harbor acceptance contract pending.
